content_blocks.text: Sheet: Revision History | Headers: Software Revision, Release Date, Summary of Changes, Related Documents | Rows: 5

rows: Minor HMI diagnostics screen updates. No change to sensors or setpoints.
Pressure sensor PS-04 replaced by PS-04A. Normal HPU discharge pressure setpoint changed from 180 bar to 200 bar. See ECN-1042.
ECN-1042, AEG-OM-700 Rev 3, AEG-MM-700 Rev 2, AEG-CR-700 Rev 2
Documentation correction: Alarm A17 condition text no longer names a specific sensor (PS-04 or PS-04A) so it reads correctly on units at either revision. Alarm thresholds unchanged. See ECN-1058.
Scheduled: extended diagnostics logging. No sensor or setpoint changes currently planned.
